name: Local LLM
description: Chat with a language model (llama.cpp) that runs inside a VM. Your conversations never leave the Mac; the only network access is downloading a model from Hugging Face. Optionally uses the Mac's GPU.

network.purpose: Downloads the model you pick (a GGUF file of 0.5 to 4.7 GB) from Hugging Face, and nothing else
Hugging Face redirects every model download to this storage host, where the file itself is served

host.purpose: Runs the model's heavy maths on the Mac's GPU instead of the VM's CPU, only while you have 'Use the Mac's GPU' switched on
